name: Daddy's Daughters
description: A family therapist falls into a rut when his wife and his clients abandon him, forcing him and his five daughters to pull together and establish a new life.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Family psychologist Sergey Vasnetsov has big problems. His wife left him leaving five daughters and mother-in-law. The eldest daughter, Masha, is windy fashionista, the second daughter, Darya, is goth, the third daughter, Evgeniya, is athlete, the fourth daughter, Galina, is A student and the youngest daughter, Polina, is a little baby. All are very noisy. And none of them know how to clean and cook. On top of that, Vasnetsov lately has no luck with customers.
